dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Select Vulnerability Topic,Start Your Penetration Journey

vulnType.authSessionDesc: Brute force attacks, authentication bypass, session management flaws and other attack methods aimed at breaking through the system's authentication mechanism
vulnType.xssDesc: Exploiting insufficient filtering of user input on websites to inject malicious script code into web pages, stealing user information or conducting other attacks
vulnType.injectionDesc: Inserting malicious data into SQL query statements to deceive the database into executing unauthorized operations, stealing, tampering with, or deleting data
vulnType.xxeDesc: Exploiting XML parser's external entity processing to read server files, make internal network requests, or cause denial of service
vulnType.csrfDesc: Tricking users into performing unexpected operations on authenticated websites, exploiting user identity and permissions to make unauthorized requests
vulnType.ssrfDesc: Inducing servers to initiate unexpected HTTP requests on behalf of applications, used to access internal network resources or probe network topology
vulnType.rceDesc: Attackers can execute arbitrary system commands on target systems, gaining server control and causing serious security threats
vulnType.accessControlDesc: Failure to properly restrict user access to resources, leading to unauthorized access, horizontal or vertical privilege escalation issues
vulnType.fileOperationDesc: Security vulnerabilities in file upload, download, inclusion and other operations that may lead to malicious file execution or sensitive file disclosure
vulnType.securityConfigDesc: Security risks caused by improper or missing security configuration of systems, frameworks or components, leading to default accounts, debug information exposure, etc.
vulnType.infoLeakDesc: Failure to properly protect sensitive data such as passwords, keys, personal information, etc., resulting in unauthorized access or theft of data
vulnType.businessLogicDesc: Flaws in application business process design or implementation that can be exploited to bypass normal procedures or gain illegal benefits
vulnType.deserializationDesc: Lack of sufficient validation during deserialization process, allowing attackers to construct malicious data to execute arbitrary code or tamper with objects
